summary.headline: Testimonies in Kings’ Nativities
summary.text: Chapter VI explains astrological testimonies indicating kingship in nativities, linking royal status and authority to the ascendant, luminous fixed stars, the midheaven, and conjunctions with the Sun or Moon. Basiliscus, Hercules, Canis Major, Spica, and planetary configurations are noted in the marginal apparatus.
